purpose: Opt-in POC equirectangular sky textures; first concept image used as art direction; dusk/night derived from generated day panorama.
day:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: a production-ready equirectangular sky panorama texture for a Godot anime game, not a scene illustration and not a contact sheet.
Create one seamless full-sphere equirectangular 2:1 panorama, 2048x1024 or larger 2:1. The equator/horizon is exactly at 50% image height, zenith at top, nadir at bottom. View directions wrap seamlessly left to right with matching sky colours and continuous clouds at the seam.
Only a brilliant clear summer SKY. Absolutely no ground, landscape, trees, mountains, buildings, bridge, sun disk, moon, stars, text or watermark. Below the horizon (lower half) continue a simple pale cool blue sky fill with almost no detail so the texture works as an environment. Top pole is a smooth deep saturated azure blue, with no objects or pinching shapes. On the upper hemisphere between 20% and 49% height draw beautiful tall white cumulus cloud groups, airy clean open sky gaps, white sunlit cloud tops with pale periwinkle blue shadow shapes. Larger cloud banks closer to horizon, smaller distant clouds at horizon.
Style: luminous Japanese anime background key frame, clean simple painted shapes, crisp but delicately softened cel cloud edges, sophisticated blue gradation, very high quality. Match the luminous clean summer sky of the supplied art-direction board ONLY, not any objects from it. No photorealistic wispy noise, no oil brush texture, no watercolor grain, no tiny high-frequency speckles. A usable sky texture rather than artwork composition.
dusk:
Use case: lighting-weather.
Edit target: this seamless full-sphere 2:1 equirectangular anime sky texture. Keep exactly the same image dimensions, cloud silhouettes and projection coordinates, left/right wrapping and horizon line.
Change ONLY to a beautiful clear late-summer sunset at 17:20, luminous Japanese anime colour design: deep periwinkle upper sky, soft rose-lavender middle sky, pale apricot light at the horizon, warm golden-pink cloud edges and lilac cloud shadow masses. Keep calm pale blue-violet regions between the golden areas; no all-orange or brown wash. Sun is to be added procedurally by the game: DO NOT draw any sun disk. Lower half stays a very simple softly blended cool lavender/peach environment fill. Keep clean flat cloud shapes and crisp fine contours; no photorealism, no brush noise, no ground/landscape/objects/text/watermark. Match day texture exactly in layout so the engine can interpolate time of day.
night:
Use case: lighting-weather.
Edit target: this seamless full-sphere 2:1 equirectangular anime day-sky texture. Keep exactly its image dimensions, projection coordinates, cloud silhouettes, horizon height and left/right wrapping.
Change ONLY to a calm blue summer night at 21:00. Upper sky deep clear ultramarine, lower sky quiet blue; cloud shapes shaded in navy and softly outlined in muted cornflower blue. A sparse handful of tiny subtle stars in the open sky only, no star clusters and no galaxy. DO NOT draw a moon, sun, horizon objects, landscape, text or watermark; the engine supplies the real light direction. Lower half is a simple dark cool-blue environment fill. Japanese anime key-frame colour design, clear large forms and controlled darkness, no photography, no painterly texture, no noise and no sparkling white clouds. Preserve exact cloud positions to blend seamlessly between time-of-day textures.
